scope: Small SFT experiment only; not full manipulation coverage or task success certification
reviewer: Astra/max direct visual inspection; not an external human annotator
checks: Current and +16 frame head/left/right views inspected for 21 stratified samples
Three tasks and base, torso, bilateral, single-arm and gripper labels represented
Active semantic skill matches visible object context
Gripper opening/closing labels are commands only, not successful grasp/place outcomes
Independent robot-only FK and 30 Hz source clock gate passed
v3 images reused only after SHA checks; no training on unreviewed v1/v2
Original per-task five-percent holdout and whole source instances excluded; public_test excluded

limitations: Millimetre-level translations cannot be quantified from 256px image pairs alone; numerical path/FK checks remain necessary
Training coverage is dominated by base and torso; rare arm/rotation classes and unrepresented classes are reported separately
No FAILED/SUCCEEDED labels were fabricated; mixed, stationary, boundary and unknown motion windows are rejected
Labels encode direction over 0.533 seconds, not exact deployment microstep amplitude
Test set remains unviewed and is for one final paired comparison; validation pictures are development data
